title: Jazz Jam @ Timucua Arts Foundation
event_description: Monthly jazz jam session with Central Florida Jazz All-Stars. Open-door opportunity for musicians to perform with a professional house band. Contemporary groove-oriented funky sounds with respect for jazz masters.
hosts: Ryan Devlin - Thomas Milovac - Per Danielsson - Gerald Law II
backline: Full backline including piano - drums - bass - sound system
event_venue_information:
About Timucua Arts Foundation

Timucua Arts Foundation is an intimate concert hall and cultural center dedicated to presenting world-class music in an acoustically refined setting. The venue hosts a diverse range of musical performances from classical to contemporary jazz.

Jazz Jam Series

The monthly Jazz Jam features a revolving cast of Central Florida's finest jazz musicians. The house band includes some of the region's most accomplished players with national performance and recording experience. Musicians are encouraged to bring their instruments and participate in this collaborative musical experience.

Other Events

Beyond the jazz jams Timucua regularly presents classical music concerts chamber ensembles and experimental performances. The venue is known for its exceptional acoustics and intimate atmosphere that creates a unique connection between performers and audience.

title: Open Mic @ The Falcon Bar & Gallery
event_description: Weekly open mic featuring original music - rap - poetry - performance art - spoken word and comedy. Welcoming atmosphere in a quirky art bar setting with craft beers and wines.
event_venue_information:
About The Falcon Bar & Gallery

The Falcon is a quirky art bar nestled in historic Thornton Park offering the finest craft beers wines and session cocktails. The venue combines an art gallery atmosphere with a neighborhood bar vibe creating a unique cultural space in downtown Orlando.

Open Mic Night

Every Tuesday night The Falcon hosts one of Orlando's most eclectic open mics. Sign-up starts at 8 PM in-person only. Performers get 3 songs or 10 minutes for music and performance art while comedians get 5 minutes. The event welcomes all forms of creative expression in a supportive judgment-free environment.

Other Weekly Events

The Falcon also hosts Thinking and Drinking Trivia Night on the third Friday of each month and Esoteric Ladies Night on first Thursdays. The venue regularly books live bands and creates a welcoming space for Orlando's alternative and artistic communities.

title: Open Mic @ Copper Rocket Pub
event_description: Weekly open mic night with amazing sound system. All genres welcome from acoustic to rock. Two dollar Tuesday specials on tacos burgers and shots make this a popular weekly event.
backline: PA system and sound engineer provided - DI boxes available
event_venue_information:
About Copper Rocket Pub

The Copper Rocket Pub is a beautifully decorated neighborhood pub in Maitland featuring original murals smoke-free environment and an impressive selection of craft beers and wines on tap. Since its relaunch in 2015 the venue has become a community hub for music lovers.

Open Mic Tuesday

Sign-ups begin at 7 PM with performances running throughout the night. Expect to play 2-5 songs depending on turnout. Featured artists occasionally get extended sets around 9:30 PM. The pub provides PA system and sound engineer but musicians should bring their own guitars and amps. The venue has a no metal/screamo policy due to PA limitations.

Entertainment Schedule

Beyond open mic nights Copper Rocket hosts trivia karaoke and live music on Saturday nights. With over 35 TVs it's also a popular spot for watching sporting events. The combination of great food cold beer and regular entertainment makes it a neighborhood favorite.

title: Acoustic Jam @ Muldoon's Saloon
event_description: Acoustic jam night with full backline provided. All musicians of every skill level welcome. Bring your cowbell and join Raleigh and Friends for an evening of collaborative music-making.
backline: Full backline including drums - bass amp - guitar amp
event_venue_information:
About Muldoon's Saloon

For nearly 50 years Muldoon's Saloon has been Winter Park's neighborhood pub and musicians' bar. This classic dive bar features live music five nights a week with never a cover charge. The venue offers both indoor and outdoor seating with a cozy fire pit adding to the charm.

Weekly Music Schedule

Mondays feature Hospitality Night Tuesdays host Full-Band Jam Night with Punch 'n Judy Wednesdays bring Karaoke Thursdays present the Acoustic Jam with Raleigh & Friends Fridays showcase live music on the patio and Saturdays feature Central Florida's best bands playing blues rock and country.

Sunday Open Mic

First Sundays of the month host an Acoustic Open-Mic and Jam Night at 8 PM hosted by Justin McLeod. The venue provides a welcoming atmosphere for performers and audiences alike with reasonably priced drinks and a true neighborhood bar feel.

title: Open Mic @ Z Co-Space & Clubhouse
event_description: Electric night of live music - stand-up comedy and spoken word poetry. Free admission with handcrafted Kava Z Tea specialty coffees and hookah available. Welcoming no-judgment zone for all performers.
event_venue_information:
About Z Co-Space & Clubhouse

Z Co-Space & Clubhouse is a unique venue that transforms throughout the day. By day it operates as a co-working space studio and art gallery. By evening it becomes a vibrant entertainment venue and lounge featuring handcrafted Kava mocktails Z Tea specialty coffees exotic teas kombucha and expertly prepared hookah.

Open Mic Wednesday

Every Wednesday brings together Orlando's most passionate performers and art lovers. The event is hosted by Museum of Madi and welcomes musicians comedians poets and all forms of creative expression. The atmosphere is warm electric and full of community spirit with a diverse and dynamic crowd of like-minded individuals.

Weekly Events

Beyond Wednesday open mics Z Co-Space hosts Sip & Save Mondays with half-off drinks Trivia Night Tuesdays and Girls Night Out Saturdays with half-price drinks and live music. The venue blends luxury art and innovative design creating a distinctive social experience.

title: Open Mic @ Fiddlers Green Irish Pub
event_description: Weekly open mic night in an authentic Irish pub setting. Musicians welcome to perform in this cozy dark oak interior space. Sign-up sheet available starting at 7:30 PM.
venue_address: 544 W Fairbanks Ave Winter Park FL 32789
event_venue_information:
About Fiddlers Green Irish Pub

Since 1996 Fiddlers Green has been bringing authentic Irish pub culture to Winter Park. The venue features elegant dark oak interiors 24 beers on tap and one of the largest selections of scotches and whiskeys in Orlando. Their fish and chips were featured on The Food Network's Best of series.

Live Entertainment

Fiddlers Green hosts open mic every Thursday at 8 PM with sign-up starting at 7:30. The venue also features Trivia Nation on Wednesday nights at 7 PM and live bands every Friday Saturday and Sunday night. The authentic Irish pub atmosphere is enhanced by traditional Irish dishes like shepherd's pie and corned beef alongside American favorites.

Community Hub

Open every day except Christmas Fiddlers Green has established itself as Central Florida's most award-winning Irish pub. The combination of hearty food cold Guinness live music and Irish hospitality creates a unique gathering place where friends and families come together to share memories and laughs.
